description: This file contains utility functions for converting session states and logging levels to string representations and setting log levels for different components within the Rialto server manager's common namespace.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a LoggingLevel enum to a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL value.

methods.name: setLocalLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for various components based on provided LoggingLevels configuration.
